name: Lumina Cognitive OS
description: Cognitive layer Niveles 1-12: Risk Engine, Environment Awareness, Memory tiers (Working/Episodic), Vision (UI Automation + multimonitor), Action Planner + Browser driver, 12-agent Director, Intent Router, MCP Gmail/Calendar/Drive, Boot Greeting and Wake-Word. Every capability is exposed as an agent tool so the user can invoke it by voice via Start Talk. Hosts the M3GAN cognitive core: safety kernel, world model, people, privacy, health and the M3GAN dashboard.

enabled.description: Enable the Lumina Cognitive OS layer.

envPath.description: Absolute path to the .env file shared with the rest of I24D.

memoryDir.description: Directory where Working/Episodic memory JSONL files are stored. Defaults to %APPDATA%/lumina-cognitive-os.

awarenessIntervalMs.description: Polling interval for the unified environment snapshot.

wakeWordEnabled.description: Run the Python wake-word sidecar (requires Python with openwakeword installed).

wakeWordModel.description: Wake-word model name. Defaults to hey_jarvis_v0.1 (openwakeword bundled model).

bootGreetingEnabled.description: Greet the user on startup with calendar/email/task context.

browserDriverEnabled.description: Enable the Playwright/CDP browser driver tool. Disabled by default — opt-in.

perceptionAutoStart.description: Auto-start the continuous semantic perception loop so Lumina always 'sees' the foreground app + its actionable UI elements. Opt-in (screen capture).

perceptionFps.description: Capture rate for the perception loop (0.5-10). Higher = fresher sight, more CPU.

skillsDir.description: Directory of agentskills.io skills Lumina can list/describe/run. Defaults to c:/I24D_WhatsApp/skills; LUMINA_SKILLS_DIR overrides.

pcOperatorProvider.description: Default brain provider for lumina_pc_do. auto preserves fallback order; a tool call can still override it.

pcOperatorModel.description: Optional default brain model for lumina_pc_do, for example gemma4:31b, gemini-2.5-flash, or a Claude/OpenAI model.

supabaseSchema.description: Supabase/PostgREST schema exposed to Lumina tools.

supabaseMaxRows.description: Maximum rows returned per table by lumina_memory_search.

supabaseAllowWrites.description: Enable lumina_supabase_memory_remember writes. Keep false unless the user explicitly wants database writes.

warehousesPath.description: Path to Lumina's existing warehouses. Catalog only; OpenClaw does not load experimental cerebro/local AI modules.

recipesDir.description: Directory of extra intent recipes for lumina_intent_run. Empty uses the built-in templates only.

bridgeUrl.description: Windows Bridge URL for UI automation and system context. LUMINA_BRIDGE_URL overrides.

operativeEnabled.description: Run the operative daemon that applies the operative rules.

operativeRulesPath.description: Path to the operative rules file. LUMINA_OPERATIVE_RULES overrides.

codeActWorkspaceRoot.description: Workspace the CodeAct loop may write to. LUMINA_CODEACT_WORKSPACE overrides.

recordingsDir.description: Where demonstrations are recorded for skill learning. LUMINA_RECORDINGS_DIR overrides.

replayAllowedApps.description: Apps a recorded demonstration may be replayed against. LUMINA_REPLAY_ALLOWED_APPS overrides.

governancePolicyPath.description: Governance policy JSON. Defaults to c:/I24D_WhatsApp/governance-policy.json; LUMINA_GOVERNANCE_POLICY_PATH overrides.

cognitiveCoreEnabled.description: Run the cognitive core: thalamic router, world model, global workspace, self model and the safety-gated body. The loop starts observe-only.

autonomyLevel.description: Initiative ceiling L0-L5 for the cognitive loop and the body. L3 notices and proposes but asks first; L4+ may act alone on pre-authorized, reversible, low-risk work.

bodyMode.description: Body adapter. 'none' on a desktop (every physical intent is refused); 'simulated' exercises the body path symbolically. A physical robot needs its own adapter.

grantedCapabilities.description: Body capabilities Dal grants. The model cannot grant itself any; only this config can.

preAuthorizedCapabilities.description: Granted capabilities that may run without asking at L4+, only when reversible and low risk. Grasping and handing objects to people always ask.

ownerName.description: The owner, registered with the owner role when nobody holds it. Config is an owner channel; the agent cannot assign roles.
